_comment: Each entry becomes a page at docs.html?doc=<slug>. 'source' can be a path relative to the site root (the .md file can live anywhere in this repo -- it does not need to sit next to this config) OR a full https:// URL to a raw markdown file (e.g. a raw.githubusercontent.com link into a completely different repository). These pages are plain documentation reads: no spine, no rotation, just the doc with the site's chrome (top bar + theme) around it.
